{"metadata":{"description":"Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in the conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent.","id":"gh:1344804187","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"a2ui-render-in-dsh","slug":"baihui-ai/a2ui-render-in-dsh","topics":["a2ui","agent-ui","ant-design-x","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","echarts","generative-ui","interactive","katex","mermaid","visualization","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"he conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# a2ui-render-in-dsh"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A2UI interactive cards for the dsh web UI**: the agent adaptively renders **interactive, visual UI"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" cards** right inside the conversation — quizzes, forms, multi-step wizards, dropdowns, date pickers"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", product cards, sortable/filterable tables, ECharts charts, China map choropleths, math function pl"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ots, Mermaid flowcharts/mind maps, KaTeX formulas, Markdown long-form, image uploads, signature pads"},{"id":"p4s5","text":", and step-by-step algorithm animations. User interactions flow back to the agent as plain-language "},{"id":"p4s6","text":"messages (images included), cards **stream in progressively** and can be **updated in place**, and e"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"verything visible is one click away from the clipboard."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The UI protocol is A2UI v0.9 (a declarative Agent-to-UI protocol); rendering is powered by Ant Desig"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n X's official implementation, `@ant-design/x-card`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"📸 **Feature showcase with GIFs → DEMO.md** · 🗺️ **Scenario × component map**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Design"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Architecture: one package, two halves"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Key design decisions"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**1. Proactive rendering, decided by the model — anchored on UI's purposes.** The tool contract fram"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"es the judgment as: would a card serve any of UI's four purposes better than prose? **Act** (the use"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"r must answer/choose/fill/adjust — render a form), **browse** (the user wants to see or scan data — "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"statistics, rankings, distributions, trends get a chart/table/map, and uncertain data never cancels "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"the card: chart the best known, label the period, caveat in prose), **understand** (structure or not"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ation aids comprehension — math, code, flows, stepwise processes), or **feedback** (long multi-step "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"work gets a progress card advanced via `a2ui_update`). None of the four → prose. Cards always **pair"},{"id":"p11s8","text":" with prose**: the takeaway lives in 1–3 sentences of normal text, the structured content in the car"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"d, with no duplication. Grounded in HCI research (Norman's gulfs, the keyhole effect, external cogni"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"tion) and verified with keyword-free prompts across all purposes plus prose negatives."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**2. Skill-style context design (catalog on demand).** The full component catalog is NOT inlined in "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"the tool description; it lives in a second tool, `a2ui_catalog`. The always-visible tool description"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" stays at ~350 tokens for 44 components (the on-demand catalog is ~2.5k, paid once per card-using co"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"nversation). The model calls the catalog once before its first card in a conversation and reuses it "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"for later cards; conversations that never draw a card pay nothing. The host validates component name"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s and errors with a "call a2ui_catalog" hint, so the model can't silently guess wrong."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**3. Non-blocking answers over the native message path.** Submissions need no custom server channel:"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" the client sends the submission through dsh's own `session.prompt` RPC as an ordinary user message."},{"id":"p13s3","text":" Messages are **plain language** (button label + chosen values, multi-line for forms) — readable for"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" humans, parseable for the model, no raw JSON in the conversation:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- 🎯 **Adaptive**: the model chooses text vs. card; verified reliable in both directions
- 🪶 **Contex"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"t-friendly**: skill-style catalog design, ~350 tokens always-visible for 44 components
- ✅ **Form va"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"lidation**: `required: true` on any input blocks submission and highlights what's missing
- 🧭 **Sess"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ion navigator**: a right-edge drawer with Tasks (to-submit / submitted groups, fill counts, previews"},{"id":"p17s5","text":", dismissable) and All (every user message in full, click-to-locate with auto "load earlier", live-r"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"efreshing); drafts survive reloads and submitted-state survives cache clears (rebuilt from the trans"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"cript)
- 🗜️ **Upload compression**: photos are downscaled client-side (≤1568px, JPEG) before flowing"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" into the prompt
- 💬 **Elegant answers**: plain-language submissions, not raw JSON strings; photos &"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" signatures return as real images
- 🔒 **Submit-once locking**: forms can't double-submit, records pe"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"rsist, a "refill" button reopens them; query buttons unaffected
- ⚡ **Streaming render**: cards appe"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ar progressively while the model is still writing the JSON
- 🔄 **In-place updates**: `a2ui_update` p"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"atches a live card by surfaceId — moving progress bars, task cards that finish themselves, refreshin"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"g dashboards; survives page reloads
- 📊 **Full visualization family**: ECharts charts/dashboards, fu"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"nction plots, China map choropleth, all Mermaid diagram types, KaTeX formulas (matrices are forced i"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"nto formula rendering), image compare slider, video
- 🎬 **Algorithm animations**: array/bars, grid/m"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"atrix, and graph/tree forms, auto-detected; auto-plays once per card (component remounts never repla"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"y), ↻ manual replay, stepping, progress bar, legend
- 🧾 **Interactive tables**: click-to-sort (numer"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"ic-aware), filter box, pagination, copy as TSV, CSV export, editable-table input
- 🧭 **Rich answer k"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"it**: multi-step Wizard, Calendar date picking, drag-free RankList ordering, Suggestions follow-up c"},{"id":"p17s20","text":"hips, Upload, Signature
- 📋 **Quick copy everywhere**: Stat tiles click-copy, tables copy/export, Co"},{"id":"p17s21","text":"deBlock copy, formulas copy their LaTeX, charts download as PNG, Markdown copies its source
